question: What signal should you give on approach when turning left at a roundabout?
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 requires signalling left on approach when taking the first exit.

question: What signal should you give on approach when going straight ahead at a roundabout?
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 says not to signal on approach when going straight ahead.

question: What signal should you give on approach when taking an exit to the right?
options: No signal until after you leave
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 tells you to signal right on approach for exits past straight ahead.

question: Why should you avoid signalling left too early when going straight ahead?
options: Waiting drivers may think you are taking the first exit and pull out
It is illegal on motorways only
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 avoids early left signals so waiting traffic is not misled.
